acceptanceCriteria: The budget assertion is load-robust (for example measured as a minimum of several runs, or moved to a benchmark/qualification) while still catching a real regression.
Ten consecutive runs pass under a parallel go test ./... load.
body: internal/liveverify/affected TestSelectionOnTheLiveDirtyWorktree failed on 2026-10-01 with 'live-worktree select=343.5ms exceeds the 100ms budget' (cold graph 1.036s, 24 dirty paths) while a Docker test run loaded the host (macOS, go1.27.1); it passed on a quieter host earlier. A wall-clock budget in a unit test fails on load rather than on regression.
title: TestSelectionOnTheLiveDirtyWorktree 100ms select budget fails under host load
